title: Basic facts at a reduced-boundary point: x ∈ U, unit reduced normal, convergence of the normal averages to it, and positive mass at every scale (parent Steps 1 and 4)
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^N, μ a measure on ℝ^N and ν : ℝ^N → ℝ^N (no further hypotheses). Let x ∈ reducedBoundary U μ ν and e := reducedNormal μ ν x = limUnder_{ρ↓0} normalAverage μ ν x ρ, where normalAverage μ ν x ρ = μ(B_ρ(x)).toReal⁻¹ • ∫_{B_ρ(x)} ν dμ. Then x ∈ U, |e| = 1, normalAverage μ ν x ρ → e as ρ ↓ 0 (along 𝓝[>] 0), and μ(B_ρ(x)) > 0 for every ρ > 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn N)) (μ : Measure (Rn N)) (ν : Rn N → Rn N), ∀ x ∈ reducedBoundary U μ ν, x ∈ U ∧ ‖reducedNormal μ ν x‖ = 1 ∧ Tendsto (normalAverage μ ν x) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (reducedNormal μ ν x)) ∧ ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → 0 < μ (Metric.ball x ρ)
